summary: Applied the three blocking spec review repairs: concrete task input source, broad implement entrypoint, and safe cursor promotion predicate.

items.title: Task-scoped requirement/file source is undefined
items.rationale: Defined rendered current task spec markdown as the task-scoped source and explicitly excluded parent requirement ID and file-map filtering for task gates.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R3, clarifications, overview decisions, and T-3 acceptance now state the task spec markdown source.

items.title: Broad implementation opt-in has no CLI integration point
items.rationale: Defined get-next-action as the implementation entrypoint for broad mode and required a matching step=implement audit record before broad run-impl can be returned.
items.evidence: spec.json R4, acceptance criteria, clarification, and T-2 implementation notes now cover broad implement opt-in.

items.title: Null cursor recovery predicate conflicts with mid-implementation failure policy
items.rationale: Replaced broad promotion wording with an explicit safe promotion predicate and added the failure case for orphaned in-progress task state.
items.evidence: spec.json R1, R2, acceptance criteria, clarification, and data flow now define the safe predicate.
